notes.title: Marimoth is now available in Brazilian Portuguese!
notes.content: You can now select Brazilian Portuguese in the Steam properties of the game.

notes.title: Free Soundtrack is now Available!
notes.content:
The Marimoth original soundtrack, composed by Édipo Thibes, is now available for download for free!

It contains 15 tracks, in both MP3 and FLAC formats.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1873390/Marimoth_Soundtrack/]Click here to see the store page[/url]

notes.title: Version 1.3.4
notes.content:
-Clarified controls;
-You can now return to menu from the pause screen.

notes.title: Version 1.3 Changelog
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed the way fullscreen works (you can now toggle it with F4)
[*] Reduced the health of the third boss
[*] Reduced slightly the health of one of the enemies
[*] Fixed the behaviour of one of the enemies
[*] Increased the possible number orbs to be gained from 50 coins (from up to 250 coins to 500)
[*] Officially added controller support:
[*]-You can now unpause the game from the controller
[*]-You can now use the analogic stick to change the volume
[*]-You can now use the back button to return to main menu
[/list]
